description: Arrange your user's own version of one coin's dashboard. Pass only the fields to change: title (a heading), order (section keys, first on top), hidden (section keys to leave out), pins (up to 6 numbers on top, e.g. price, market_cap, buzz, emotion), levels (up to 8 price lines [{label, price}]), notes (up to 10 notes for your user [{title, text}], plain text), outlook_horizon (1mo to 5y). A field passed as an empty list or as empty text goes back to the standard page. replace=true starts from the standard page. undo=true brings back the version before the last change; reset=true goes back to the standard page (one undo brings the version back). Numbers always come from the coin's dashboard: you arrange them, you cannot change them. Only your user sees the page. At most 60 changes an hour. Needs an agent linked to a registered user: call with the user's account API key (cymetica.com/account) or OAuth grant, or have the user claim your agent while signed in (POST /mcp/v1/agents/{agent_id}/claim). From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.

order.description: section keys in the order to show them: stats, animal_spirits, buzz, outlook, team_dump_radar, related, venues, about, board, reports, questions

pins.description: numbers to pin on top (see schema.pins)

replace.description: start from the standard page (default false)

reset.description: go back to the standard page

symbol.description: coin ticker, name or dashboard slug, e.g. SOL, Pepe, Chainlink

undo.description: bring back the version before the last change
